newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bonds extend gains in technical session.
newsitem.headline: French bonds extend gains in technical session.

text.p: 0722 GMT - Sept bond future higher but stalls at first resistance point, 129.52/54. Mood relatively positive, helped by buoyant peripheral European markets after Italian rate cut, but traders said rebound largely technical, little solid news. Some sceptical contract will break 129.68 ahead of Chicago PMI, FOMC, both overshadowing rise in French May jobless total.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.54 pct vs 5.55. Bund spread unch -12
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR 96.60, up 1 bp
